import unittest

from solution import apply_revisions


class ApplyRevisionsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_applies_left_to_right_and_creates_unknown_records(self):
        snapshot = {"a": {"x": 1, "keep": 2}}
        revisions = [
            ("a", {"x": 3, "new": [1]}),
            ("b", {"created": True}),
            ("a", {"x": 4}),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            apply_revisions(snapshot, revisions),
            {"a": {"x": 4, "keep": 2, "new": [1]}, "b": {"created": True}},
        )
        self.assertEqual(snapshot, {"a": {"x": 1, "keep": 2}})
        self.assertEqual(revisions[0][1], {"x": 3, "new": [1]})

    def test_empty_revisions_still_deep_copy_snapshot(self):
        inner_list = [{"value": 1}]
        inner_set = {"x"}
        mutable_tuple = ([2],)
        snapshot = {"a": {"list": inner_list, "set": inner_set, "tuple": mutable_tuple}}
        result = apply_revisions(snapshot, [])

        self.assertEqual(result, snapshot)
        self.assertIsNot(result, snapshot)
        self.assertIsNot(result["a"], snapshot["a"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["a"]["list"], inner_list)
        self.assertIsNot(result["a"]["list"][0], inner_list[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result["a"]["set"], inner_set)
        self.assertIsNot(result["a"]["tuple"], mutable_tuple)
        self.assertIsNot(result["a"]["tuple"][0], mutable_tuple[0])

        result["a"]["list"][0]["value"] = 9
        result["a"]["set"].add("y")
        result["a"]["tuple"][0].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(inner_list, [{"value": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(inner_set, {"x"})
        self.assertEqual(mutable_tuple, ([2],))

    def test_patch_values_are_deep_copied(self):
        patch = {"nested": {"items": [1]}, "tuple": ({"x": 2},)}
        revisions = [("new", patch)]
        result = apply_revisions({}, revisions)

        patch["nested"]["items"].append(3)
        patch["tuple"][0]["x"] = 7
        self.assertEqual(result["new"]["nested"]["items"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(result["new"]["tuple"][0], {"x": 2})

        result["new"]["nested"]["items"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(patch["nested"]["items"], [1, 3])

    def test_wrong_container_and_value_types(self):
        calls = [
            lambda: apply_revisions([], []),
            lambda: apply_revisions({1: {}}, []),
            lambda: apply_revisions({"a": []}, []),
            lambda: apply_revisions({}, ()),
            lambda: apply_revisions({}, [["a", {}]]),
            lambda: apply_revisions({}, [(1, {})]),
            lambda: apply_revisions({}, [("a", [])]),
        ]
        for call in calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    call()

    def test_revision_tuple_length(self):
        for revision in ((), ("a",), ("a", {}, 3)):
            with self.subTest(revision=revision):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    apply_revisions({}, [revision])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
